name: libgen-mcp
description: Federated search of books and papers, with citations, open-access retrieval and reading, from Claude.
long_description:
libgen-mcp exposes four focused tools — search, get_details, download and read — for federated search of books and scholarly literature, ready-to-paste citations, and retrieving and reading the text. It searches the Library Genesis catalog alongside a set of open-access sources.

Search across collections (nonfiction, fiction, articles, magazines, comics, standards) with field and sort controls — and consult keyless extra sources (Anna's Archive, arXiv, Crossref, OpenLibrary, Project Gutenberg, dblp, PubMed, ERIC) merged alongside the catalog, which by default happens automatically whenever the catalog comes up empty. Pull full metadata for any record by md5, id or doi, with a ready-to-paste BibTeX/RIS citations export and opt-in Crossref/OpenLibrary enrichment. Download books (by md5, or by ISBN from the openly licensed book sources) or articles (by DOI) to a local directory, and read/paginate the text of a file the server fetches by md5 or doi (or an absolute local path you pass) — including search-within-document (find) and table-of-contents (outline) modes — without opening it yourself. Book downloads try Library Genesis, then a fresh-mirror fallback, then Anna's Archive, and an ISBN is served from OAPEN and public-domain Internet Archive scans; article downloads lead with the open-access providers — Unpaywall (when a contact email is configured in LIBGEN_MCP_UNPAYWALL_EMAIL), OpenAlex, Europe PMC, bioRxiv/medRxiv, the RFC Editor, NIST, Schloss Dagstuhl, the ACL Anthology, Zenodo, SciELO, the FAO Knowledge Repository, Internet Archive Scholar and CORE (when LIBGEN_MCP_CORE_KEY is set), then the publisher's own Crossref-deposited link and OAPEN — before falling back to Sci-Hub and the Anna's Archive SciDB viewer.

Every setting is optional — no token or account is required. Configure the mirror, download directory, request timeout, a maximum download size, the log level, the Unpaywall contact email and the CORE API key from the extension settings.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Library Genesis catalog across collections with field, paging and sort controls; returns file results with metadata and md5.

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Fetch full metadata for a record (description, identifiers, DOI, cover, related edition) by md5 or by edition/file id.

tools.name: download
tools.description: Download a book (by md5 or ISBN) or article (by DOI) to a local directory; returns the saved path and size. The serving source is not named — pin one with source to restrict the download to it.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Extract and paginate the text of a book or paper — resolved server-side by md5 or doi, or from an absolute local path — so you can read it without downloading the whole file yourself.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.description: Force a specific Library Genesis mirror, e.g. https://libgen.li. Leave empty to auto-select a reachable mirror.

timeout.title: Request timeout
timeout.description: Timeout per HTTP request as a Go duration, e.g. 10s or 1m (max 10m). Not the budget a download source gets to resolve an item — that is LIBGEN_MCP_RESOLVE_BUDGET, which defaults to 30s.

max_download_bytes.title: Maximum download size (bytes)
max_download_bytes.description: Reject downloads larger than this many bytes. 0 means no limit.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error.

unpaywall_email.title: Unpaywall email
unpaywall_email.description: Contact email for the Unpaywall API, used to resolve open-access articles by DOI. Recommended if you download research papers; leave empty to disable Unpaywall. The other open-access sources (OpenAlex, Europe PMC, bioRxiv/medRxiv, the RFC Editor, NIST, Schloss Dagstuhl, the ACL Anthology, Zenodo, Internet Archive Scholar) and the Sci-Hub/SciDB fallbacks work without it.

core_key.title: CORE API key
core_key.description: API key from core.ac.uk (free registration) enabling the CORE open-access article source. Leave empty to leave CORE out of the download chain.
